name: G1 FOUR
summary: A ZD2 pedal, not the ZDL family. A clean-room effect with no Zoom bytes runs on firmware 2.00 and is removed again. Modwerk lists no ZD2 effects yet.

firmware.flash: Effects (.ZD2) are installed over USB MIDI with the pedal's own file commands (zoom-zt2) or with Zoom's Guitar Lab; the OS is not modified.
firmware.recovery: Turn autosave off and keep custom effects out of saved patches. A crashing effect is cleared by a power cycle, which loads the last saved patch; then remove its file and effect-list record. Never power-cycle during a file transfer.

research.label: Zoom-G1Four-Custom-Fx
research.note: MIT, by Blindsmyth. A clean-room gain built with Stomphacks' pipeline, Tape Chorus grafted onto a stock effect, G1 FOUR ABI notes, safety rules and a dated hardware test log on firmware 2.00.

research.label: zoom-zt2
research.note: MIT, by mungewell. SysEx file and effect-list tools for the ZD2 pedals; its README reports G1 FOUR testing.

research.label: Stomphacks
research.note: MIT, by Thomas Hammer. ZD2 effects from C with no Zoom bytes, for the MS Plus series; its pipeline and gain kernel also run on the G1 FOUR. Safety rules and an effect-author ID ledger.
